meta.scope: Taiwan Batch 5 — Cross-strait economic statistics (MAC), agriculture & fishery, financial-sector (banking/insurance) detail, and remaining high-value supporting nodes. Explicit referenced_by lists for force-layout edge strength.
meta.strategy_note: Cross-strait statistics from the Mainland Affairs Council are a distinctive institutional product that strengthens the ECFA and China-partner trade edges. Agriculture/fishery completes sectoral coverage; FSC banking/insurance statistics deepen the financial cluster.

candidates.title: Cross-Strait Economic Relations Statistics (Mainland Affairs Council)
candidates.description: Regular official compilation of cross-strait trade, investment, and people-to-people exchange statistics. Draws on Customs, Investment Commission and immigration/tourism sources to present a coherent picture of economic interaction across the Taiwan Strait.
candidates.notes: Unique institutional product. Parallel in spirit to Korea’s official North Korea statistical indicators. Creates strong, explicit edges between the ECFA node, China-partner trade, investment flows and people-exchange series.

candidates.title: Agriculture, forestry and fishery statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Agriculture / Fisheries Agency / DGBAS
candidates.description: Statistics on agricultural production value, farm households, fishery production and related rural indicators. Completes the primary-sector coverage alongside manufacturing and services.
referenced_by: Regional contrast (agricultural counties vs special municipalities)
candidates.notes: Sectoral completion node. Also feeds the regional-contrast edges (eastern and agricultural counties are ageing faster and less dense).

candidates.title: Banking sector statistics (loans, deposits, soundness)
candidates.publisher: Financial Supervisory Commission / Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
candidates.description: Statistics on the banking system — outstanding loans and deposits, asset quality, capital adequacy and related soundness indicators. Complements the CBC monetary aggregates and Financial Stability Report.
referenced_by: CBC Financial Conditions and monetary aggregates
candidates.notes: Deepens the financial cluster. Strong edges into monetary, stability and real-estate/credit nodes.

candidates.title: Insurance sector statistics (life and non-life)
candidates.description: Regular indicators of the insurance industry — premiums, assets, claims, solvency and related metrics for life and non-life insurers. Taiwan’s life-insurance sector is large relative to GDP.
referenced_by: Financial Stability Report and FSC overview statistics
candidates.notes: Completes the major financial-institution triad (banks, insurers, securities). Relevant to household balance-sheets and ageing-society financing.

candidates.title: Outbound and inbound investment statistics (Investment Commission)
candidates.publisher: Investment Commission, Ministry of Economic Affairs
candidates.description: Official statistics on approved outbound investment (including the large historical stock directed to Mainland China) and inbound FDI. Key source for cross-strait and global investment patterns.
candidates.notes: Tightens the investment and cross-strait clusters. Historical Mainland China share of outbound investment remains large even as diversification proceeds.

candidates.title: Securities and capital-market statistics
candidates.publisher: Financial Supervisory Commission / Taiwan Stock Exchange related
candidates.description: Statistics on equity-market capitalisation, trading activity, listed-company performance and related capital-market indicators. Semiconductor and electronics firms dominate market capitalisation and trading.
candidates.notes: Links the high-tech industrial cluster to capital-market outcomes and household wealth.

candidates.title: Crime and justice statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of Justice / National Police Agency / related agencies
candidates.description: Official statistics on reported crime, clearance rates, prosecution and judicial caseloads.

candidates.title: Broader environmental statistics (air, water, waste, protected areas)
candidates.description: Statistics on air and water quality, waste generation and treatment, protected areas and related environmental indicators that complement the GHG inventory.
referenced_by: National GHG Inventory and Climate Change Response Act
candidates.notes: Expands the environmental cluster beyond GHG.

candidates.title: Internal migration and household registration statistics
candidates.publisher: Ministry of the Interior / Department of Household Registration
candidates.description: Statistics on internal migration flows, household registration changes and related population-mobility indicators that underpin regional concentration patterns.

candidates.title: External debt statistics
candidates.publisher: Central Bank of the Republic of China (Taiwan)
candidates.description: Statistics on external debt by sector and maturity, complementing the large FX-reserve stock and persistent current-account surplus.
referenced_by: Balance of Payments and international investment position
candidates.notes: Completes the external-vulnerability picture alongside reserves and BOP.
